name: 86 Chaos 16.0.76 Schedule Tab Runtime Guard Fix

releaseTitle: 86 Chaos 16.0.76 Schedule Tab Runtime Guard Fix
notes: Time Clock & Schedule no longer crashes from an undefined myNextShift reference on Schedule/My Schedule render.
Active clock punch sync now uses an index-light listener and a plain-English warning instead of locking the Schedule tab behind runtime recovery.
The targeted source test now checks the Schedule tab render order so this class of ReferenceError is caught before deploy.
